[{"Name":"Bishnu Pratap Singh","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX1ZHFo4x3i1pp5K6Z1tDL53aXzwxTZTU7j0TckvqvEhU5S0KlnSA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"My experience with Universal College of Medical and Dental Sciences Teaching Hospital (UCMS), Nepal has been truly excellent.

The doctors here are not just knowledgeable, but more importantly honest, ethical, and deeply dedicated to patient care. I am not comparing doctors based on degrees or expertise, but on honesty and commitment, and in that sense, UCMS stands far above many hospitals.

In India, especially in Gorakhpur, I have personally seen that once the EDD date approaches, many hospitals do not wait for the natural process. They often create fear by mentioning unnecessary complications and strongly push for C-section deliveries, mainly for financial reasons. This is the unfortunate reality in many Indian hospitals.

Initially, my wife was receiving treatment at one of the best hospitals in Gorakhpur during the early stage of pregnancy. But when we felt that things were not going in the right direction, we decided to shift to UCMS Hospital — and that decision changed everything.

At UCMS:

Doctors are very patient, transparent, and supportive

Nurses and staff are extremely caring and cooperative

The hospital maintains excellent cleanliness and hygiene

No unnecessary pressure for surgery; the natural process is fully respected

My daughter was born 4 days after the EDD, and that too through a normal delivery, which would likely not have been allowed in many hospitals in India.

I am truly grateful to the doctors, nurses, and the entire staff for their care and support.
The only small drawback is that there is no paid accommodation for patient attendants, but apart from this, everything is excellent.

Thank you UCMS Hospital.
Thank you to the doctors, nurses, and staff.
You gave us trust, care, and a beautiful beginning for our daughter’s life. ❤️","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Traveller Nepal","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXI0PVZhBOoXrDSVqIPZMYcrUEaqoC_wM_6j0Swf5734HFzlbU=s120-c-rp-mo-ba6-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"Universal College of Medical Sciences or UCMS is the only medical college in Bhairahawa. [{"Name":"Xtinna Onosé (Cristina)","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVhvss16Gl50yftbadVsOrIrnyvfkGJQLqGp0aey17UT8rm8jR3og=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"I took the morning route from Kathmandu to Lumbini — the bus departed at 7 AM and took about 11 hours. There were plenty of stops along the way, which made it much more manageable.

Our driver, Madhu, was absolutely fantastic and deserves a 10-star rating for his skill and professionalism!

A heads up: most of the highway is currently under construction and can be quite bumpy at times. We were fortunate to get delayed only once or twice in construction zones, but overall, the drive was steady.

The bus itself was a bit older but still comfortable. It took some time to leave the city as passengers boarded from various locations, but once we were on the main road, the trip went smoothly.

Make sure to reserve your seat in advance—tickets were sold out a couple of days before departure. You can pay in advance or directly on the bus.

user_reviews:
[{"Name":"Florine Leroy","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJcGaqnGP2Vc8YkELWl0F0XvE5Achy2gLmlEAUVEdgQSN5G4Q=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Wahou, que dire  .. cette famille est juste extraordinaire !

Le logement est situé sur le rooftop de la maison familiale. Il est de très bonne qualité et neuf. Vous disposerez d'une grande chambre de trois personnes, avec sa salle de bain (eau chaude et serviette comprise), ainsi qu'une cuisine et d'un espace extérieur (fauteuil, table, balancelle). Il y a tout à disposition (très bonne wifi, fil à linge, épingle, cintre, eau filtrée, de quoi grignoter ...). Rien à redire, mieux que ce que j'avais espérer que j'ai changé mes plans pour prolonger mon séjour.
Facile à trouver, l'emplacement sur Booking est bon ou via Google maps sous le nom "Gautam BNB", près de Buddha Chowk.
Idéalement situé au calme et à 1 minute à pied de la route principale où vous pouvez prendre les tuktuk ou les bus locaux (pour aller à Lumbini par exemple). Toutes commodités aux alentours (restaurants, boulangerie, grand supermarché à 10min à pied etc)

En ce qui concerne cette famille, ils ont été d'une gentillesse incroyable. Nous avons échangé quelques discussions, ils m'ont offert le thé et le dinner à deux reprises. Ils m'ont aidé à trouver le bus et le matin de mon départ, le monsieur est allé sur la route principale pour faire amener un tuktuk directement et me conduire, au prix local.
Leur sourire et leur hospitalité sont sans failles.

Très bon rapport qualité prix, je recommande les yeux fermés !!

Merci 🙏❤️","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Saurabh","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJoo4buZJfGH5jVgrNHtk9GwM3q0asGroruPkNli56iDQFz5CQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Aman Nishad","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXIoUq_lIO9ylEOI6-JRvzln21VlT1P1bJvPRIS3MTchHbd_cRY=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Sangam Singh","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJ9XdthXTojKcZAM4ejHOr3BWI7RBoTqkQd5vsfZf_irHAxvw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"","Images":null,"When":""}]

This park is famous for its lush greenery, well-maintained gardens, and serene environment, making it a popular destination for locals and tourists alike.

The park features:

Beautiful Landscapes: With its manicured lawns, diverse flora, and picturesque scenery, Banbatika Park offers a perfect spot for relaxation and picnics.

Walking Trails: The park has several walking paths where visitors can enjoy a leisurely stroll or engage in jogging.

Family-Friendly Facilities: It is equipped with play areas for children, making it an ideal place for family outings.

We ordered three non-vegetarian mutton thalis, two naans, and a mix of vegetables. While the naan and mix veg were satisfactory, the mutton was extremely disappointing. It seemed old and poorly cooked, accompanied by an unpleasant smell.
When we brought this issue to the attention of our waiter, we unfortunately received no response. Frustrated, I approached the kitchen to address the matter directly with the chef. He acknowledged the smell and admitted there was indeed a problem with the mutton. This raised serious concerns—are they playing with our health?
To make matters worse, we noticed that not only the mutton, but the dal also had a bad smell, which fellow diners at nearby tables echoed. Initially, the restaurant served fresh food, but it seems they were recycling leftovers during our visit.
When we raised our voices at the counter regarding the situation, the staff merely acknowledged the issue with the mutton and suggested it should have been thrown out. It's unacceptable for a restaurant to serve food that poses health risks to its customers.
I have always recommended Aagan Restaurant and Thakali Ghar to my guests and friends, but after this experience, I can confidently say that this will be my last visit. We did not pay for the three mutton thalis but settled the remaining amount before leaving, feeling thoroughly disappointed.
I hope they take this feedback seriously and improve their food safety standards.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCCGeMlARfVRZ-GCZg3Ekan&fid=0x0:0x43b90b88881b2890"],"When":"2025-11-10"},{"Name":"Dimpal Rayamajhi","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIPzCQ-2FeBQ0PEVk2vZ5ui1lP8HvrNx__I1v1welYu3jGA8g=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We went there to celebrate my chhori’s birthday, and we are truly grateful for the warm hospitality and excellent service. The restaurant also serves fried garlic cloves and pakauda made from fish eggs that taste delicous..
The place is not so social for family gathering and most of the visitors are those who want to take alcoholic drinks like beer, whiskey, etc.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhB5meUZXYPXlSvfHq15q15L&fid=0x0:0x8bfed1013317d9a"],"When":"2025-8-13"},{"Name":"Palpa And Beyonds","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUwHq8bUS8AklnQihyJSUbG9GtUSQgoC2gC9S6pH1RzgQdddXw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba7-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"If you’re a fish enthusiast and happen to be in Bhairahawa, Santosh Fish Restaurant is an absolute must-visit. Tucked away from the bustling main roads yet easily accessible, this exclusive restaurant has built a stellar reputation for offering some of the finest fish-based culinary delights in the region.

From the moment you enter, the aroma of freshly prepared local fish dishes hits you, promising a memorable dining experience. The ambience is simple but clean and inviting, with a focus on letting the food speak for itself. Whether you're dining solo, with family, or entertaining guests, the atmosphere is relaxed and comfortable.

The star of the show here, of course, is the fish. Freshwater varieties, sourced daily, are cooked to perfection using traditional Nepali spices and cooking techniques. Signature dishes like the spicy grilled fish, fish curry, and crispy fried fish have earned loyal followers. Their special house-made chutneys and pickles add a delightful kick to every bite.

What sets Santosh Fish Restaurant apart is not just the taste, but the consistency. The fish is always fresh, never overly oily, and cooked just right – moist inside with beautifully crisped skin when fried or grilled. Their use of local ingredients adds an authentic touch that’s hard to replicate.

The service is courteous and efficient. The staff are knowledgeable about the menu and often recommend dishes based on the catch of the day. Prices are reasonable, offering great value for the quality of food served.

Santosh Fish Restaurant stands as a proud local treasure in Bhairahawa. Whether you're a local resident or a traveler exploring Lumbini Province, this place is a delightful stop for a truly authentic fish feast.
